topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: The thin .opencode/commands/*.md pairs (closure.md 557b, ask.md 186b, auto.md 2297b, refresh-context.md 517b, execute.md 365b) do NOT carry the rich ## Fail-safe reason codes and ## Stop conditions sections that their .cursor/commands/*.md counterparts do (closure.md 10252b, ask.md 2914b, auto.md 39231b, refresh-context.md 5793b, execute.md 23328b). Wanted: copy those two rich sections into the thin counterparts (closure.md first; then ask, auto, refresh-context, execute) while preserving active->template byte-parity (BUG-0031 precedent: shipped delta byte-identical across active + template).

.opencode/commands/{closure,ask,auto,refresh-context,execute}.md (THIN) and template/.opencode/commands/{closure,ask,auto,refresh-context,execute}.md (mirror). Source: .cursor/commands/{closure,ask,auto,refresh-context,execute}.md (RICH). Composable US-0120 (closure phase), US-0125 (thin opencode commands + validator bridge), US-0126 (reason codes + --scope=opencode-adapter parity), BUG-0031 (byte-identical active+template precedent), BUG-0027 (manual-phase evidence persistence), US-0156 (OpenCode /auto parity).

active->template byte-parity must hold (BUG-0031 precedent). .opencode/agents/* unchanged; .opencode/plugins/orchestrator.ts unchanged; template/.cursor/commands/* unchanged. US-0120/US-0125/US-0126 contracts unchanged; BUG-0031 curator-allow-set UNTOUCHED; BUG-0006/US-0048 spawn-only UNTOUCHED; .opencode/tui.json stays plugin=[] (BUG-0030/DEC-0151 lock). No npm-publish, git-push, .env reads. INTAKE_AUTONOMY_MODE=0 + INTAKE_SUBAGENT_FALLBACK=deny (config.json) unchanged.

New test_bug0033_* markers (8) verify: (1) .opencode/commands/closure.md has both ## Fail-safe reason codes and ## Stop conditions; (2) .opencode/commands/ask.md has both; (3) .opencode/commands/auto.md has both; (4) .opencode/commands/refresh-context.md has both; (5) .opencode/commands/execute.md has both; (6) active .opencode/commands/*.md and template/.opencode/commands/*.md are byte-identical; (7) bug_issue_validate.py --check-acceptance exit 0; (8) US-0125 (thin dispatch-only) and US-0126 (reason codes) tests do not regress.

BUG-0033 is DONE when the five thin opencode command files (closure, ask, auto, refresh-context, execute) contain the rich ## Fail-safe reason codes and ## Stop conditions sections, active+template are byte-identical, 8 test_bug0033_* markers PASS, bug_issue_validate.py --check-acceptance exit 0, and no US-0125/US-0126/BUG-0006 regression. Intake = register, not close - no ACs checked.
